title: iss071e111824
author: NASA/JSC
description: iss071e111824 (May 23, 2024) -- As the International Space Station orbited 257 miles above Tibet, Lake Manasarovar (right) and Lake Rakshastal (left) were photographed. Fed by the Kailash Glaciers, Manasarovar is a high-altitude freshwater lake, connected to its neighboring saltwater lake by the Ganga Chhu river.
